blocks.text: Elevate your outdoor living space with the Visola Outdoor Sofa, designed for style and durability. Featuring a contemporary gray finish with a textured wood look, this patio sofa blends modern design with natural charm. Built from HDPE material, it offers exceptional weather resistance and long-lasting performance, making it ideal for any outdoor setting. Thick seat and back cushions, along with two coordinating throw pillows, provide ultimate comfort for lounging or entertaining. Wrapped in solution-dyed Nuvella® high-performance fabric, the cushions resist fading and stains and are easy to clean—just use mild soap and water or a bleach solution for tougher spots. The all-weather foam cushion core ensures lasting support, while the sturdy frame stands up to the elements season after season. Perfect for patios, decks or backyard seating areas, this outdoor sofa combines durability, comfort and timeless design. Assembly required.
